meta.title: FEAT-009 · Register a shop and become a seller
meta.subtitle: Design solution from technical-design.md: a verified buyer registers a shop on the seller host and gains the Seller role. Pick a flow to follow one UC-003 path; click any arrow for its data contract.
meta.description: A signed-in buyer follows the storefront header's "Seller centre" link to the seller host. The seller centre's guard probes its own session (hs.bff.sel); a visitor is sent through the seller OIDC client, and the shared Identity session (hs.idp) signs them in without a password (ADR-0027). A buyer without the Seller role lands on SCR-SEL-001 and submits a name and a seller type. Identity validates the fields, reads email verification from the database, refuses a second shop or a taken name (case-insensitive), then commits the shop, the Seller grant, a seller_role_granted audit row and the ShopRegistered outbox row in one transaction. The SPA forces a session refresh so the access token carries role Seller, and the dashboard (SCR-SEL-002) reads GET /v1/shops/me, a seller-only endpoint guarded by the role claim (FR-ROLE-003).
overview: FR-SHOP-001..004, FR-ROLE-002, FR-ROLE-003; supports FR-SHOP-008, FR-ROLE-004, NFR-SEC-006, NFR-SEC-009
SCR-SEL-001, SCR-SEL-002 (setup checklist), seller-centre account menu
POST /v1/shops, GET /v1/shops/me (policy seller), event ShopRegistered/v1, gateway routes, seller-centre session
new table shops (unique owner, unique normalized name); audit type seller_role_granted, method nullable
FEAT-001, FEAT-002, ADR-0027 wiring (all on main)

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.desc: The buyer. Holds hs.idp (Identity session, storefront host) and one BFF cookie per host: hs.bff.stf and, after the seller-host sign-in, hs.bff.sel. Never holds a token.

nodes.label: Storefront SPA
nodes.desc: Unchanged. The existing header link Seller centre (design.md §3, from lg; mobile menu panel below md) opens VITE_SELLER_ORIGIN for everyone; the seller-centre guard decides where the user lands (D-10).

nodes.label: Seller centre SPA
nodes.desc: features/auth: session store, account menu, guard (anonymous → /bff/login; no Seller → /register-shop; Seller on /register-shop → /), language saved to the profile. SCR-SEL-001 /register-shop: name, seller type, field errors, name taken, unverified with resend. SCR-SEL-002: shop name and setup checklist from getMyShop.

nodes.label: Gateway + BFF
nodes.desc: New routes shops-root and shops to Identity, default authenticated; CSRF header on non-GET. The seller host already has its cookie, OIDC client hivespace-seller, /bff/user, /bff/session/refresh and /bff/logout (ADR-0027). No role check here (D-2).

nodes.label: Identity
nodes.desc: Domain: ShopName (3–60, NFC lower-case normalized), SellerType, Shop.Register, User.GrantRole, AuditEntry.SellerRoleGranted. Application: RegisterShopHandler, GetMyShopHandler, IShopStore. Api: ShopEndpoints; policy seller = bearer + role: Seller. Tokens re-read roles on every refresh.

nodes.label: identitydb
nodes.desc: New shops: id, owner_user_id (unique), name, normalized_name (unique), seller_type (individual / business), timestamps. audit_entries: type seller_role_granted, method nullable. role_grants unchanged.

nodes.label: Service Bus
nodes.desc: Outbox relay, at least once. ShopRegistered/v1 reaches only existing subscriptions (inventory, notification); Catalog and Search-AI subscribe in later slices (§8).

nodes.label: Notification
nodes.desc: Has no handler for ShopRegistered: acknowledges it, records the inbox row, sends nothing (T7).

all.title: FEAT-009 design solution
all.intro: Reach the seller centre with one sign-in, register a shop, refresh the session, open the dashboard; and the refused paths.

register.title: Register a shop (UC-003 main)
tags: AC-1, AC-2, AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-11

steps.t: Submit name and seller type on SCR-SEL-001; POST /v1/shops relayed with the bearer.
One transaction: shop, Seller grant (Buyer kept), audit seller_role_granted, outbox ShopRegistered; 201 MyShop.
Event relayed after commit; Notification acknowledges it without sending anything.
Session refresh on the seller host: the new access token carries role Seller.
Dashboard reads GET /v1/shops/me: shop name and the checklist (pickup address, payout not done).
Seller centre in the storefront header opens the seller host.
Guard probes /bff/user on the seller host; with no hs.bff.sel it goes to /bff/login?returnUrl=….
Authorize for hivespace-seller finds hs.idp: no password; the callback sets hs.bff.sel.
Routing: no Seller role → SCR-SEL-001; Seller → dashboard.
Invalid fields: 400 common.validation_failed, one detail per field; nothing read or saved.
Unverified email (read from the database): 403 identity.email_not_verified; the page offers resend.
Already owns a shop: 409 identity.shop_already_owned; the SPA refreshes and opens the dashboard.
Name taken (case and spacing ignored): 409 identity.shop_name_taken on the name field. A lost race at commit gives the same codes.
Buyer-only token on GET /v1/shops/me: policy seller refuses, 403 common.forbidden. No session: 401 at the gateway.
Seller token: always the caller's own shop (sub); a spoofed X-User-Id changes nothing.

notes.b: Shop, Seller grant, audit and outbox in one SaveChanges (architecture §5.2).

notes.t: Role checked from the token, in the service
notes.b: Policy seller; staleness only delays access and the SPA refreshes right after registering.
The claim may predate the verification; the page refreshes the session once when it says unverified.
No requirement states a length; confirm the limit at review. Accent-sensitive matching.
One shop per user makes a retry return 409 already owned, handled as success.
Catalog and Search-AI subscribe later; shops registered before then in a shared environment need a backfill.
The header link only, no role-aware account-menu item; the seller-centre guard routes from its own fresh session. Gap md–lg accepted.
The plan lists Catalog, Search-AI and Notification as ShopRegistered consumers; they belong to FEAT-011/012, FEAT-018 and FEAT-032.
